title: Closed Areas Regulation, Schedule 5, section 62 (Squamish)

source.version: BC Laws consolidation current to October 13, 2026

source_text:
Schedule 5 No Shooting Areas (Section 6)
Squamish
62 That portion of the Province of British Columbia within the following described boundaries: Commencing at the southeast corner of the District Municipality of Squamish; thence due East to the 400 m contour line; thence northerly along the contour to the point of its intersection with Gonzales Creek; thence up the creek to the 600 m contour line; thence northeasterly to its intersection with a road which lies between the Stawamus River and Shannon Creek; thence northeasterly down the road to its crossing of the Stawamus River; thence down the river to its intersection with the boundary of the District of Squamish; thence westerly and southerly along the boundary line of the District to the point of commencement, excepting any Indian Reserve lands.
